dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and continuous narrowing of the 2D body width from the mid-section toward the posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minor localized indentation on the right lateral margin in the posterior third of the visible frame.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Median pixel intensity corresponds to a light slate-grey skin tone.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency distribution of darker grey patches concentrated primarily along the central dorsal ridge.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse, low-contrast gradients between the darker mottled regions and the primary light-grey canvas.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Distinct dark punctate marks visible along the longitudinal dorsal midline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint linear markings/striations visible on the dorsal surface, likely superficial scratches.
